selection.universe: All rows on independent current PumpSwap DEX pages 1–4, sorted by documented h24_volume_usd_desc. Not a historical or exhaustive census.
selection.leadRule: Valid public addresses; canonical PumpSwap SOL-quoted PDA address consistency; index-created age >=0 and <=6h at that page receipt. Index time remains UNVERIFIED, not an on-chain migration proof or current support validation.
selection.activityFilter: NONE: retain every qualifying lead, including zero-activity and weak controls.
selection.outcomeSelection: NONE: population frozen at completion, before any later outcome retrieval.

limitations: Population is current-indexed and bounded by five h24-volume-ranked pages; it is biased and nonexhaustive.
Index-created timestamps do not establish genuine migration times. Future matching must use actual on-chain origin proof.
Canonical address consistency does not prove current mint, pool, fee or vault support.
Reported transactions, volume, price changes and liquidity are provider claims, not confirmed trade flow or actual-size executable prices.
No top-winner or opportunity-recall percentage is supported. Weak controls remain in the frozen lead population.
Only HTTP response body bytes are measured. Packet/TLS overhead, request bytes and infrastructure transfer allocations remain unverified.
Zero additional public API subscription/key cost does not mean zero infrastructure cost.
